info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, raftFront, cableGuy, swellList, swellListPointer, loopWidth, loopX, swellHeight, swellListPointerStartglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDListon getPropertyDescriptionList me  descriptionList = [:]  addProp(descriptionList, #swellHeight, [#default: 0, #format: #sprite, #comment: "Sea Swell Height"])  addProp(descriptionList, #swellListPointerStart, [#default: 1, #format: #sprite, #comment: "SwellListPointer Start"])  return descriptionListendon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  cableGuy = sprite(6)  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 50  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  swellAngle = random(360)  swellList = []  swellListPointer = swellListPointerStart  repeat with i = 1 to 90    swellAngle = i * 4    swellList.add(swellHeight * cos(swellAngle * radians))  end repeatendon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    xDiff = this.locH - cableGuy.locH    if abs(xDiff) < 35 then      yDiff = this.locV - 20 - (cableGuy.locV + cableGuy.Yvel)      if yDiff < 0 then        cableGuy.Yvel = cableGuy.Yvel + (yDiff * 0.25)      end if    end if    this.locH = Xpos    swellListPointer = swellListPointer + 1    if swellListPointer > 90 then      swellListPointer = 1    end if    this.locV = Ypos - swellList[swellListPointer]  end ifend
info.name: Pleasure Vessel
